title: MCTF in Action Newsletter
intro: The quarterly MCTF in Action newsletter, formerly called Prevention in Action, is designed to help service members, families, veterans, and civilians build life skills and strengthen their Marine Corps Total Fitness (MCTF). The newsletter focuses on what to do instead of what to know or what not to do.

sections.markdown:
The quarterly MCTF in Action newsletter, formerly called Prevention in Action, is designed to help service members, families, veterans, and civilians build life skills and strengthen their Marine Corps Total Fitness (MCTF). The newsletter focuses on what to do instead of what to know or what not to do.

If you want to receive the newsletter via email, have content ideas, questions, or would like to highlight an initiative, contact [hqmcprevention@usmc.mil](mailto:hqmcprevention@usmc.mil?subject=Prevention%20newsletter).
